resources.string: This app provides the necessary video content and streams for Mimasu. It runs in the background and is called directly from the main app to ensure a seamless streaming experience.

As mentioned above, this automatically integrates to Mimasu. It uses a self-build AI to match the shows in the app with the available services. This AI is currently limited to match the shows itself, it may fail and episode matching is unavailable, resulting in wrong streams. You can report such occurrences on GitHub.
You will be notified about updates in the main app. Please download them from GitHub directly.
